tables.title: TABLE VI. - OVERALL PERFORMANCE (a) Nominal nonrotating rotor tip clearance, 0.061 cm
tables.notes: Readings 3364, 3365, 3366 (100 %), 3367 (90 %), 3368 (80 %), 3362, 3361, 3363 (70 %), 3369 (60 %), 3370 (50 %), in printed order under the speed headings. Parameters as rows, reading numbers in the header row; every speed of this clearance in one file (PERCENT OF DESIGN SPEED gives the speed). No units printed (row 2 blank). Read from a 300-dpi render (the text layer is unusable). Checks, all pass: temperature-rise efficiencies from the pressure and temperature ratios (the stage efficiency with the stage temperature ratio); annulus/frontal flow 1.3447-1.3449 and orifice/frontal flow 0.1976-0.1977 on every reading; rotative speed/percent speed 16090-16108 rpm; head-rise coefficient over (PR^k - 1) times (N/N_design)^2 = 1.613-1.625.
